physicalNotes: Radius 0.08097753 Jupiter radii from Hord et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..233H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..233H/abstract): 5,789.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.00217 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
